cause_quote: The scoped session UI introduced `const iconReason = patchReason({ icon: null });` and `const colorReason = patchReason({ color: null });`, leaving both actions on the default `sessionScope = false` path.
user_saw: Users with session-only write access could not change or reset their own session icons and colors, and Profile could show an unlinked Discord account while an existing link was on another account.
summary: The fix uses the existing own-session permission and captured session ID for appearance changes across the sidebar, Chat header, and Sessions page, and defaults Profile to a linked Discord account while preserving explicit selections.
reasoning: I used the owned-session permission failure as the primary defect because it affected all three appearance surfaces. PR #155184 introduced scoped UI admission and opted actions such as rename into it while leaving icon and color on the broad-write path, so appearance failed for session-only writers from the start. I also verified that the separate Profile defect shipped with PR #188910, which initialized the selection with `this.accounts[0]?.accountId`.
